def power_set(nums: List[int]) -> Set[List[int]]:
    """
    Computes the power set of a given list of numbers.

    The power set is the set of all possible subsets of the input set.

    Args:
        nums: The input list of numbers.

    Returns:
        A set containing all subsets of the input list. Each subset is represented as a list.

    n = len(nums)
    # The power set will have 2^n subsets.
    # We can iterate from 0 to 2^n - 1. Each number's binary representation
    # corresponds to a subset: if the j-th bit is set, the j-th element of nums
